extra_vocab.en: able to be paid back to you
extra_vocab.note: 這篇談的是合約續約與取消條件，費用能不能退是議價時常出現的重點。refundable 用來說明錢在某些條件下可以拿回來，常和取消期限一起出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「不可退款」要用 non-refundable（non- 加連字號），不要寫成 unrefundable。

example.en: We paid a refundable deposit when we signed the service agreement.
example.zh: 我們簽服務合約時付了一筆可退還的訂金。

example.en: The booking includes a non-refundable fee for processing the request.
example.zh: 這筆預訂包含一筆處理申請用的不可退費用。

example.en: The ticket is fully refundable if you cancel before the trip.
example.zh: 如果你在行程前取消，這張票可以全額退款。

examples.en: The deposit is refundable if you cancel within seven days.
examples.zh: 如果你在七天內取消，這筆訂金可以退還。

examples.en: Please note that the registration fee is not refundable after May 1.
examples.zh: 請注意，五月一日之後報名費不予退還。

examples.en: Is the advance payment refundable if the supplier delays delivery?
examples.zh: 如果供應商延遲交貨，預付款可以退還嗎？

confusable.diff: returnable 指「商品」可以退回；refundable 指「錢」可以退還。

example.en: These unopened boxes are returnable, and the store will refund the price.
example.zh: 這些未拆封的箱子可以退貨，商店會退還價款。

confusable.diff: reimbursable 指員工先墊付的費用可由公司補還；refundable 指付給對方的錢可以退回來。

example.en: Travel costs are reimbursable if you attach receipts to the expense form.
example.zh: 如果你在費用表上附上收據，差旅費用可以報銷。

example.en: We left a deposit to hold the meeting room for Friday.
example.zh: 我們付了訂金，保留星期五的會議室。

example.en: The company will reimburse you for hotel costs within two weeks.
example.zh: 公司會在兩週內補還你的飯店費用。

derived.link: re-（回）+ fund（資金），把錢退回去；refundable 就是 refund + -able，「可以被退款的」，像 readable、changeable
同樣的拼法當名詞，重音移到前面，指「退回來的那筆錢」
non-（不）+ refundable，加 non- 表示否定，像 non-stop

extra_vocab.en: money you pay at the start and may get back later
extra_vocab.note: 在續約與維護合約的情境中，security deposit 是為了保障對方而先付的一筆錢，期滿且沒有損壞或違約時通常會退還。
extra_vocab.pattern: pay / return + a security deposit + for + N
extra_vocab.grammar_note: security deposit 是可數名詞，要說 a security deposit；退還用 return 或 refund the deposit。

examples.en: The landlord requires a security deposit equal to one month's rent.
examples.zh: 房東要求一筆相當於一個月租金的押金。

examples.en: The vendor will return the security deposit after the contract ends.
examples.zh: 合約結束後，廠商會退還保證金。

examples.en: Please transfer the security deposit before we ship the equipment.
examples.zh: 請在我們出貨設備之前匯出保證金。

similar.diff: deposit 比較泛指訂金或存入的款項；security deposit 特別指為了保障對方而預先付的保證金。

example.en: The hotel asked for a deposit to confirm our booking.
example.zh: 飯店要求付訂金來確認我們的預訂。

confusable.diff: down payment 是購買價格的頭期款，不會退還；security deposit 是保證金，期滿沒問題才退還。

example.en: The down payment counts toward the price, but the security deposit is returned.
example.zh: 頭期款會算進價格裡，但保證金會退還。

extra_vocab.zh: 分期付款的一期款項、分期
extra_vocab.en: one of several payments that you make over time
extra_vocab.note: 這篇在談續約價格與費用，installment 是議價時常見的付款方式，指把一筆費用拆成幾次付清。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 美式拼法是 installment，英式是 instalment；「分期付款」常說 pay in installments，in 後面接複數。

example.en: We will pay the fee in three equal installments this year.
example.zh: 我們今年會分三期等額支付這筆費用。

example.en: Customers may pay in installments instead of paying the full amount.
example.zh: 客戶可以分期付款，不必一次付清全額。

example.en: Each monthly installment includes the service fee and tax.
example.zh: 每個月的分期款都包含服務費和稅金。

example.en: The vendor offers an installment plan for the maintenance contract.
example.zh: 廠商為維護合約提供分期付款方案。

example.en: We will send the final installment once the work is approved.
example.zh: 工作驗收通過後，我們會寄出最後一期款項。

examples.en: The first installment is due on the day we sign the contract.
examples.zh: 第一期款項在我們簽約當天到期。

examples.en: Please confirm that you received the second installment of the payment.
examples.zh: 請確認你已收到第二期款項。

examples.en: Can we split the cost into four installments instead of two?
examples.zh: 我們可以把費用分成四期，而不是兩期嗎？

confusable.diff: install 是動詞「安裝」；installment 是名詞「分期款項」，兩個字拼法相近但意思完全不同。

example.en: The vendor will install the system after the first installment arrives.
example.zh: 第一期款項到帳後，廠商會安裝這套系統。

confusable.diff: deposit 是一次付的訂金；installment 是分次付款中的其中一期。

example.en: We paid a deposit today and will pay the first installment in June.
example.zh: 我們今天付了訂金，並會在六月支付第一期款項。

example.en: The payment was sent to your account on Monday.
example.zh: 款項已在星期一匯到你的帳戶。

example.en: Please pay the balance before the contract expires.
example.zh: 請在合約到期前付清尾款。

example.en: The loan has a low interest rate and flexible terms.
example.zh: 這筆貸款利率低，條件也很有彈性。

derived.link: installment 的詞幹；install + -ment，把動作變成名詞，像 payment、agreement

senses.en: one of several payments that you make over time

example.en: Each installment is due on the first day of the month.
example.zh: 每一期款項都在當月第一天到期。

senses.en: one part of a story or series that is published over time
senses.distinguish: 看到 story、series、magazine 等字就是連載的一期；看到 payment、fee、plan 就是分期款。

example.en: The magazine will print the next installment of the story in May.
example.zh: 雜誌會在五月刊登這個故事的下一期。
